# spotlight_line (List Resource)

Lists the lines in a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "spotlight_line" "core" {
  provider = spotlight

  config {
    workspace_id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57"
    team_id      = "9c2e6d5a-1f47-4c8b-9a3d-2b7e5f0c1d84"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace to list in.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) Lists only what this team has; every team's when left out.
